Class ModDataComponentTypes

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.register.ModDataComponentTypes
public final class ModDataComponentTypes extends Object
The DataComponentTypes that carry every bucket family's persistent per-stack state. Runtime bucket behavior accesses these components through BucketState; loader registration code enters the instances into Registries.DATA_COMPONENT_TYPE, and data-driven item construction may write a component directly. Each persistent codec reads saved data through BucketStateMigration, which brings older formats up to the current one first; the codecs here describe only the current format.

FLUID_CONTENT, MILK_AMOUNT, POWDER_UNITS, and CAPTURED_MOBS are the mutually exclusive content group a bucket write clears before selecting one; JUNK_CONTENTS is independent and coexists with any of them.

    • validateMilkAmount

      public static com.mojang.serialization.DataResult<Integer> validateMilkAmount(int amount)
      Checks that a milk amount is a whole number of buckets. Milk never passes through a loader fluid API, so it only moves in bucket-volume units.
      Parameters:
      amount - milk amount in millibuckets
      Returns:
      the amount, or an error when it is not a positive multiple of one bucket-volume
